name: Secondary export-restricted market: NVIDIA H800 80GB PCIe (bare card, ASKING band)
price_basis: USED/secondary-market ASKING prices, bare H800 80GB PCIe cards, USD, observed 2026-10-03. NOT a sold price. Excludes tax/shipping.
notes: ACCELERATOR-ID CORRECTION (2026-10-03, parent agent): accelerator_ids previously read nvidia-h100-pcie, which is a different part in a different market (H800 is the export-controlled China-market H100 variant with reduced NVLink and FP64). Repointed to nvidia-h800-80gb. NOTE: no nvidia-h800-80gb accelerator record exists in the repo yet -- this is a known dangling reference and should stay a warning, not be silently dropped. OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-picclick-ebay-asking. OBSERVED: three listings at $33,900 / $41,221.28 (twice - two different sellers running the identical Chinese-language title, so the duplicate is one price quoted twice, not two observations). Effective band $33,900-$41,221 with n_effective=2. Recorded deliberately as its own segment and NOT as an H100: the H800 is the export-control-downgraded Hopper (reduced NVLink/interconnect), it is not an H100, and folding it into an H100 band would import the interconnect restriction into the price. export_controlled is true for the underlying part under the US export-control regime; the listings themselves are third-party resale, whose legality varies by destination.
